subject: Request: short checklist for security-gated trial credits (VPC POC)
messages:
From: Sam Levin <sam.levin@odinhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@odinhealth.com
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Shielded trial / credits for VPC proof-of-concept

Hi Evelyn,

Quick note from our side — Odin Health is preparing a 6-week VPC-based proof-of-concept to validate integration for our clinical ingestion pipeline. Security is requiring that any external vendor provide a short checklist of required evidence and, separately, confirmation of any promotional credits or trial top-ups you can offer that are restricted to shielded/private deployments.

Can you: 1) send a short, prioritized checklist of the items Redwood needs to verify for a security-gated VPC POC; and 2) confirm whether Redwood can issue a credits top-up specifically scoped to the VPC trial (we'll need it segregated from hosted API credits). If yes — what approvals and timeline are typical?

We'd like to present a concrete ask to procurement this week so they can route a PO if needed.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Levin
Director of Platform Engineering, Odin Health
security_ops@odinhealth.com

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sam Levin <sam.levin@odinhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Shielded trial / credits for VPC proof-of-concept

Hi Sam — thanks for the clear ask and for the topology diagram. High-level answers up front: yes, we can provide a scoped credit allotment for a Private/VPC POC and we have a short, audit-friendly checklist that speeds approvals. Approval typically requires Sales + Security signoff (Ben/Soohjin internally) and a brief evidence packet from your side. Timeline from initial request to credit issuance is usually 48–72 business hours after we receive the minimal evidence set.

Priority checklist (minimal set to unblock a shielded VPC POC):
- SOC 2 report or attestation (if available) OR 3rd-party security questionnaire answers (we can accept a partial initially)
- Network topology (you included — good). Add a short note on egress control and private peering configuration
- Data classification statement: confirmation that production PHI/PII will not be ingested during the PoC or an explicit takedown plan if it is
- KMS requirements & preferred provider (AWS KMS / HSM details)
- SSO / SCIM requirements and test accounts for the PoC
- Expected request volumes and tokens estimate (helps size the credit)
- PO or billing contact + any contract/legal items that need to be pre-signed (we can accept a PO to expedite)

I attached a short "prelim-evidence-template.docx" you can use to populate the items above — it reduces back-and-forth. Suggested credit sizing: we typically offer an earmarked trial credit (applied only to Private deployment usage) that maps to the POC length and expected throughput. For a 6-week VPC sandbox with moderate traffic we usually start with $8k–$15k equivalent credits; we can finalize after you provide the token/throughput estimate.

Next steps:
1) Fill the attached template and return to me + Ben.
2) Ben will start the internal approval path (sales manager + finance).
3) Security (Soohjin) will do a brief technical review — usually a one-hour call.

If you want, Marissa can join to scope the model variant and quantization profile that will minimize cost during the PoC.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.com
(Attachment: prelim-evidence-template.docx)

Sam — looping in Redwood security (Soojin) and noting the internal approval path. From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Approval: conditional trial credits for Odin Health VPC POC

Hi Sam / Odin team —

Following review of the provided topology and the partially completed evidence template, Security is comfortable with a conditional approval for a scoped VPC POC. Summary of decision and conditions below.

Decision:
- Redwood will earmark $12,000 in trial credits for Odin Health (Deal: DN-47821). Credits are restricted to Private/VPC deployment usage and will not apply to hosted API endpoints. Credits will be issued within 72 business hours of receiving a PO or signed SOW referencing this POC.

Conditions (required before credits are released):
1) Signed mutual NDA (we received your sent copy; please confirm countersignature) or an equivalent confidentiality addendum.
2) Completed minimal evidence template (SOC2 or questionnaire answers for items listed in Evelyn's email).
3) Agreed data handling rules documented: no PHI/PII ingestion during PoC unless explicitly approved and monitored; retention capped at 30 days for PoC artifacts unless otherwise requested.
4) KMS integration details and test key provisioning for the PoC (ephemeral keys preferred).
5) A 45–60 minute security scoping call with Redwood Engineering (please propose two slots).

Limitations and notes:
- The credits are time-bound to a 45-day window starting on the first day of production traffic in the VPC. Unused credits do not convert to cash or hosted credits.
- Redwood retains the right to pause the trial if we detect misconfiguration that exposes credentials or open egress.

Attachments included: signed-nda.pdf (stub), security-questionnaire.pdf (template)

Next suggested steps:
- Odin: return the completed template and confirm a PO path to procurement@redwood.com
- Redwood: finance will prepare a one-time credit grant and operations will spin up the dedicated nodes after PO and security checklist confirmation

Happy to jump on a call — propose Thu Aug 26 at 10:00 or Fri Aug 27 at 14:00 PT.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
(Attachments: signed-nda.pdf, security-questionnaire.pdf)
